rows.vgi.doc_md:
# Supported Excel formats

A curated, zero-argument reference relation you can browse to learn which Excel formats this worker handles — no file or credential required.

Each row describes one workbook format:

- **format** — the exact tag `detect_excel` returns (`xlsx` or `xls`).
- **description** — the format's full name and Apache POI backend (XSSF for OOXML, HSSF for legacy OLE2).
- **container** — how the bytes are packaged on disk.
- **readable** / **writable** — whether `read_excel` / `excel_sheets` can parse it and whether `write_xlsx` can produce it.

Both formats are readable; only the modern `.xlsx` format is writable. Query this relation to branch on format capabilities before reading or writing a workbook.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"sql":"SELECT format, description, container FROM excel.main.formats ORDER BY format;","description":"Browse every Excel format the worker understands with its container."},{"sql":"SELECT format FROM excel.main.formats WHERE writable ORDER BY format;","description":"List only the formats write_xlsx can produce."}]
rows.vgi.title: Supported Excel Formats

rows: CREATE VIEW formats AS SELECT format, description, container, readable, writable FROM (SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('xlsx', 'Office Open XML workbook (OOXML / XSSF)', 'ZIP / PK-signature container', true, true), ('xls', 'Legacy binary workbook (OLE2 / HSSF)', 'OLE2 compound document', true, false)) AS valueslist) AS t(format, description, container, readable, writable) ORDER BY format;
